headline: No scored news; lines drift as earlier stories fade
body: A quiet day with no scored events. Scores shifted by only hundredths of a point as the effects of earlier announcements faded. Enslaved God still leads at 35.94, ahead of Conquerors at 27.53 and Self-Destruction at 26.69. Horizon Balance stayed at -7.63, unchanged in practice.
movers_note: Only small drifts as earlier news faded: Conquerors -0.09 and Descendants -0.09.
